configurePresets.name: ninja-msvc-release
configurePresets.description: Canonical production build. Ninja drives the build graph (single-graph parallelism beats per-vcxproj /m), sccache caches every .obj keyed on preprocessed input (second clean rebuild is mostly cache hits), /Z7 embeds debug info via CMP0141 (no mspdbsrv.exe serialization). The AiDAProtector POST_BUILD step runs on every end-user binary (AiDAStandalone.exe, aida_core.dll, AiDA.dll). This is the only supported build configuration. Run from a 'x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022' so cl.exe is on PATH, or use the VS Code task which calls vcvars64.bat first.
